name: print-social-carousel-grey-mint-digital-tech-outline-icons
title: Grey and mint digital-technology carousel with outline icons
whatItIs: An eight-post-plus-cover Instagram grid for a 'Digital Technology' brand, using grey and mint-green tiles with chunky outline icons (chip, cable, gear) and a mix of photo and flat text tiles.
whatItMeans: A cool grey-and-mint corporate palette paired with friendly rounded outline icons balances a 'serious tech' feel with approachability, avoiding an overly clinical look.
techniques: mix photographic tiles with flat icon-led tiles within one grid for content variety
use thick rounded-stroke outline icons rather than thin technical line icons for a friendlier tone
reserve one bold accent color (mint) to highlight key words within otherwise neutral tiles

vocabulary.definition: the thickness of an icon's or line's outline, affecting how bold or delicate it reads
